redToGreenTestEdits.detail: Two mechanical edits, neither of which removed, relaxed, or conditionalized an assertion. One added an explicit [CoreErrorCode] annotation to an array literal whose element type was not inferable while the injector type was absent. One moved a Thread.isMainThread read into a synchronous nonisolated helper, because the SDK annotates that property unavailable from an asynchronous context; the observation is unchanged, only the call site is.

manualProbeCommands.defaultState: Skipped when the variable is unset or empty, so no ordinary run can post an event or move the cursor. Observed skipped with its reason string in the green run.
manualProbeCommands.authorDidNotRunReason: The dispatch instruction is explicit that the author must not execute the real probe; the reviewer executes it after code review. The author therefore moved no cursor and observed no OS behavior, and claims nothing about either. The probe's fail-closed parsing was instead proven by an ordinary always-running automated test, manualProbeSelectionFailsClosedAndIsSkippedByDefault, rather than by running the probe with a bad value.

No sleep was added and no step claims delivery.

coreGraphicsInitializationCorrectionSess.finding: Root reviewer High finding, reproduced twice from a clean test process: 'env -u MACKVM_M1_036_MANUAL_PROBE swift test --disable-sandbox --package-path Packages/MacPlatform' builds, then the Swift Testing bundle hangs indefinitely before output. The reviewer's one-second /usr/bin/sample of the live helper showed several concurrent M1-036 tests blocked in makeOpaqueStubEvent or MacMouseMoveInjectionEnvironment.live.makeMouseMoveEvent -> SLEventCreate / SLEventCreateMouseEvent -> CGSEventSourceForID -> CGSScoreboard -> SLSServerPort -> _dispatch_once_wait / __ulock_wait, with other tests, including the real M1-035 trust-read test, concurrent. The reviewer terminated only the hung Swift test PIDs. Relayed by the reviewer; the author did not observe the hang.
coreGraphicsInitializationCorrectionSess.correction: Every automated M1-036 test-side CGEvent creation (opaque stub, recording platform live creation, explicit live-environment test) goes through SerializedTestEventCreation, one test-only NSLock in the test file. New always-running test everyAutomatedEventCreationRouteCreatesInsideTheOneTestOnlyGate pins the boundary with a task-local observer. No sleep, retry, timeout, production lock or test-order dependence. The opt-in manual probe is outside the gate and was not run.

pureUnitSeamCorrectionSession.author: Claude Opus 5
pureUnitSeamCorrectionSession.finding: Relayed by the reviewer; the author did not observe it. The gated tree built successfully and a clean full suite hung again. The post-fix /usr/bin/sample showed one M1-036 thread owning SerializedTestEventCreation while blocked in SLEventCreate -> CGSScoreboard -> SLSServerPort initialization, two ordinary M1-035 tests concurrently blocked in hasAuthorizationForControlComputer -> TCCAccessRequest, and every other M1-036 event test waiting behind the test lock. Serializing only M1-036 event creation cannot break this cross-framework initialization cycle.
pureUnitSeamCorrectionSession.correction: MacMouseMoveInjectionEnvironment now creates and posts an opaque internal MacMouseMoveEventHandle with identity equality. The live value wraps the real CGEvent from CGEventCreateMouseEvent and posts exactly that event, so CoreGraphics calls, arguments and order are unchanged; only the live seam in MacMouseMoveInjector.swift can wrap or unwrap an event. SerializedTestEventCreation, its boundary test, the opaque stub helper and the always-running live-creation test were removed. Ordinary tests create only MacMouseMoveEventHandle.synthetic() handles, which wrap no event. Real creation and posting remain only in the opt-in Tier-H probe, with pre-creation, restore through the injector, cleanup-only fallback, no sleep and closed vocabulary unchanged. New always-running tests: syntheticHandlesAreEqualOnlyToThemselves and the static source audit onlyTheTierHLiveRegionNamesLiveEventCreationPostingOrTheProductionSeam. M1-035 is not modified. No production or global lock, sleep, retry, unsafeBitCast, fake CF object or test-order dependence.
pureUnitSeamCorrectionSession.productionSourceChangeScope: Internal event-handle seam only. No package or public declaration changed, and no CGEvent, CGPoint or handle reaches the package surface.
